# Operator labs

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_evidence_index.py from labs/*/lab.sh and interop driver headers. Do not edit by hand; run `python3 scripts/generate_evidence_index.py --write`. -->

Each lab runs with `just lab <name> up|verify|break|explain|down`; the
walkthrough is [Operator labs](../docs/tutorials/operator-labs.md).
The slug is the shared navigation name for the lab, its cookbook page, and
the [curated interop legs](../docs/interop.md#curated-leg-index).
Related legs are protocol evidence for the scenario; they do not certify the
lab's fault and explain phases.

| Lab | Slug | Exercise | Cookbook | Related interop legs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `just lab ixp` | `route-server` | Guided route-server RPKI and import-policy exercise. | [route-server](../docs/cookbook/route-server.md) | [`m83-routeserver-multistack`](../tests/interop/scripts/test-m83-routeserver-multistack.sh) |
| `just lab monitoring` | `monitoring-feed` | A BMP collector outage leaves the BGP session and selected route intact. | [monitoring-feed](../docs/cookbook/monitoring-feed.md) | [`m24-bmp-frr`](../tests/interop/scripts/test-m24-bmp-frr.sh) |
| `just lab quickstart` | `quickstart` | Guided RFC 8212 exercise using the existing two-node Compose demo. | none | none indexed |
| `just lab rr` | `route-reflector` | Diagnose an unintended duplicate prefix announcement to a route reflector. | [route-reflector](../docs/cookbook/route-reflector.md) | [`m14-rr-frr`](../tests/interop/scripts/test-m14-rr-frr.sh) |
